messages.content: 你能告訴我克里斯蒂亞諾·羅納度在英超聯賽的曼聯俱樂部的歷史進球數，然後將其與曼聯在同一聯賽中的最佳射手進行比較，最後告訴我誰是2019-2020賽季英超聯賽的最佳射手嗎？

function.name: team_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team_name.description: The name of the football team.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

function.name: league_stats_get_top_scorer
function.description: Fetch the top scorer of a specified football league. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

league_name.description: The name of the football league.

season.description: Season for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is '2019-2020' if not specified.

function.name: player_stats_get_all_time_goals
function.description: Fetch all-time goals scored by a particular football player for a specified team. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

player_name.description: The name of the football player.

team_name.description: The name of the team for which player has played.

competition.description: Competition for which to fetch stats (optional). Default is 'Premier League' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user asks: "Can you tell me Cristiano Ronaldo's all-time goals scored for Manchester United in Premier League, then compare with Manchester United's best scorer in same league, and finally tell me who was the Premier League top scorer in 2019-2020 season?" We need to use the provided functions.

We have three functions:

1. team_stats_get_top_scorer(team_name, competition?) -> returns top scorer for a team in a competition.

2. league_stats_get_top_scorer(league_name, season?) -> returns top scorer for a league in a season.

3. player_stats_get_all_time_goals(player_name, team_name, competition?) -> returns all-time goals for a player at a team in a competition.

We need to get Ronaldo's all-time goals for Manchester United in Premier League. Then we need Manchester United's best scorer in Premier League. Then we need the Premier League top scorer for 2019-2020 season.

We can call player_stats_get_all_time_goals with player_name="Cristiano Ronaldo", team_name="Manchester United", competition="Premier League". That will give us his total goals.

Then we call team_stats_get_top_scorer with team_name="Manchester United", competition="Premier League" to get the team's top scorer.

Then we call league_stats_get_top_scorer with league_name="Premier League", season="2019-2020".

We should do them sequentially. We'll call each function separately. We'll output the results.
